title: JSON text and JSONB result conversion

scope.rationale: jsonReturnStringAsBlob and jsonReturnTextJsonFromBlob are the two allocation-owning conversion boundaries between generated canonical JSON text and JSONB. The registered result owners now use both helpers for JSONB function output and array/object extraction text output.
excluded_responsibilities: Text parser and JSONB-to-text recursive translation bodies

external_source_responsibilities: convertTextToBlob validates and appends JSONB nodes
translateBlobToText validates and renders one JSONB root
SQL result owners copy then release returned owned slices
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete source functions are assigned. returnString invokes text-to-JSONB conversion for JSON_BLOB output, and returnFromBlob invokes JSONB-to-text conversion for array/object text results.

inputs: Well-formed generated JSON text or one borrowed complete JSONB root
Allocator used for all intermediate and returned storage
outputs: Independently owned JSONB bytes or canonical JSON text
contracts.ownership: The returned slice transfers to the caller. Intermediate JsonParse/JsonString allocations are released on all success and failure paths.
contracts.state_and_results: Text conversion requires a complete valid JSON document and returns editable owned JSONB. Blob conversion copies the borrowed input into a parse owner, validates its root during translation, and returns owned canonical text.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, or I/O; allocator and translation calls only.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Malformed, too-deep, and OOM errors propagate without leaked output. Registered result owners translate the error and remain safely reset/finalizable.

representation_differences: Owned Zig slices replace SQLITE_DYNAMIC result ownership. Callers publish transient results then free the slices synchronously.
JsonParse owns a copied JSONB slice in the blob-to-text direction rather than borrowing aBlob directly, preserving one allocator domain and simple cleanup.
Errors return through a typed local error set rather than writing directly to sqlite3_context.

oracle.protocol: Convert generated object/array text to JSONB and back to exact canonical text, exercise malformed and allocation failures, then run jsonb_set and jsonb_array_insert through prepared SQL and inspect blob/text conversions.
internal_observations: JSONB root type and payload span
prepared SQL storage type and rendered JSON
oracle.normalization: Compare exact JSONB bytes where stable and exact canonical text/error categories otherwise.

assurance.oom: All intermediate owners use defer/errdefer and return OutOfMemory without publishing partial results.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Pure connection-local conversion; no I/O or shared state.
assurance.malformed_input: Text parser and JSONB translator reject malformed complete roots; no borrowed input mutation occurs.
assurance.continuation: Each result is independent and callers can continue or finalize after an error.
assurance.performance: Linear translation with one returned owned copy; blob-to-text additionally copies the borrowed JSONB into the parse owner.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/json_text.zig conversion owner and src/core/internal/json_functions.zig result publisher
integration.native_call_path: returnString uses returnStringAsBlob for JSONB result flags; returnFromBlob uses returnTextFromBlob for array/object text extraction; prepared JSONB functions exercise both directions.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The unused blob-to-text helper is now connected to production array/object extraction, replacing duplicated inline translation there.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C round-trip and fault differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add maintained pinned-C JSON text/JSONB conversion and allocation-failure differential trace.
